short_description: Vice Replay Details: what the race HUD shows in Rockstar's own GTA 6 gameplay ("GTA VI: An Extended Look"). Night street race: 6 racers, a PROGRESS bar (6% to 9%) and a race timer; the driver moves from 5th to 3rd between 00:05.52 and 00:07.44. Dirt-bike race: 12 riders and a lap counter (LAP 1/2). Every number here is read straight off the footage. No story spoilers. Footage: official Rockstar gameplay, original audio removed.

short.headline: LOOK AT THE CORNER
short.text: Look at the corner of this GTA 6 street race. This is Rockstar's own gameplay.
short.text_es: Mira la esquina de esta carrera callejera de GTA 6. Es el gameplay oficial de Rockstar.

short.headline: 5TH TO 3RD
short.text: Six racers. The driver jumps from fifth to third in under two seconds, and the progress bar keeps climbing.
short.text_es: Seis pilotos. Pasa del quinto al tercero en menos de dos segundos, y la barra de progreso sigue subiendo.

short.headline: THIS ONE HAS LAPS
short.text: The dirt bike race is different: twelve riders, and a lap counter instead of a progress bar.
short.text_es: La carrera de motos es distinta: doce pilotos y un contador de vueltas en vez de barra de progreso.

short.headline: PROGRESS BAR OR LAPS
short.text: So Rockstar's footage shows two race styles: one with a progress bar, one with laps.
short.text_es: O sea, el gameplay de Rockstar muestra dos estilos: uno con barra de progreso y otro con vueltas.

short.headline: WHICH ONE FIRST?
short.text: Which one are you racing first? Tell me below, because
short.text_es: ¿Cuál vas a correr primero? Dímelo abajo, porque
